intro.default: Hourly billing works best for audits, troubleshooting, open-ended consulting, and any project where scope is still being defined. Hours are tracked and reported transparently.

volumeDiscountText.default: Blocks of 20+ prepaid hours receive a 10% discount off the applicable hourly rate. Hours remain valid for 90 days. Ideal for clients with ongoing ad-hoc work across multiple service areas.
